description: This file defines the PostObject class within the Aws\S3 namespace, which facilitates creating and managing an S3 POST object, including form attributes, inputs, and policies for uploading files directly to S3.

classes.name: PostObject
classes.description: A class enabling the construction and management of an S3 POST upload form, including setting attributes and inputs, and handling policies and signatures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PostObject with a client, bucket, form inputs, and a JSON policy (encoded as needed). Sets up form attributes and inputs, including credentials-based signature.

methods.name: getFormAttributes
methods.description: Returns the array of form attributes for the POST form.

methods.name: getFormInputs
methods.description: Returns the array of form inputs.

methods.name: getJsonPolicy
methods.description: Returns the JSON policy used in the form, as a string.

methods.name: generateUri
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URI for the S3 endpoint, considering path-style or virtual-hosted–style URLs.

methods.name: getPolicyAndSignature
methods.description: Generates and returns the policy and signature data needed for the POST form, based on provided credentials.
